sections.title: Overcoming Obstacles with 'ellenére' and 'dacára'
sections.content: Both *ellenére* and *dacára* express 'in spite of / despite'. They take the possessive or unmarked form: *a nehézségek ellenére* ('despite the difficulties'), *a honvágy dacára* ('in spite of homesickness').

items.spanish: A kezdeti nehézségek ellenére sikeresen megalapozta új életét.
items.english: In spite of initial difficulties, he successfully established his new life.

items.spanish: Az eltelő évtizedek dacára sem felejtette el gyermekkori barátait.
items.english: Despite the passing decades, she did not forget her childhood friends.
